title: Police call explosion at nursing home near Philadelphia ‘mass casualty incident’
summary: People at Silver Lake healthcare center in Bristol Township injured and trapped inside after partial building collapse An explosion at a nursing home just outside Philadelphia collapsed part of the building and left people injured and trapped inside, authorities said.
